sutta: is indeed a thing uncontrollable 1.3.2 monks i know not of any other single thing so controllable as the cultivated mind the cultivated mind is indeed a controllable thing i stopped here for a while to comment so if the mind is not cultivated now it is very difficult to control it in fact when we practice meditation especially samatha meditation we are exercising control over the mind every moment when we the mind tries to run away we bring it back to one single object it runs away again because that is the tendency of the mind you know to run or if you always keep on running and we bring it back to one object so every moment we are exercising control over the mind and if we keep on doing that then when somebody arises then we are able to samadhi is the result of controlling the mind so when we have samadhi then the mind is controlled already and and that's why the buddha says there's no other single thing so controllable now as a cultivated mind
